title: The trace to its level

members.role: the line runs on to the datum the sentence names and stops there; the tip lands lit in the series' own bloom
on the date's word its x tick springs into an accent pill and a dotted guide drops from the tip to it
on the number a ring lands on the tip, the dashed level runs to the value axis ({y}) and the level is written off the rule (C14)

does: A line draws on to the datum the sentence names, its date becomes a pill on the x axis, and on the number a ring lands on the tip and a dashed level runs to the value axis with the level written beside it, never on the rule.

use_when.act: TURNS - a series read off as one number (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R21)
use_when.shape: a line whose last drawn datum is the number the sentence says, on a page whose end tag does not already print it
use_when.use: a sentence that names a date and a level ('Last year: a hundred and twenty-one billion'): trace to the datum, pill the date, ring the tip, run the level to the axis and write it
use_when.dont: the level is a value already on the chart - a rule or the series' end tag (E53 addendum; H row 15's 5.5 is a rule); a level the page's arithmetic does not give (E28)

source: P71 T36 (harvest v2 R21; DOM 00:39-00:50.5, BOOM 00:36-00:41.5); proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t36.py on Steel and Paper H row 16 ('Between 2020 and 2024 ... a hundred and twenty-one billion', take 256.48 s) on ev-debt-issuance-line-v1 - no approved cut carries it
